mapper.sql: WITH banks AS(SELECT b.* FROM question_bank b WHERE bank_visible(b.id) AND bank_matches_category(b.id,#{filter.collegeId},#{filter.majorId},#{filter.grade})), results AS( SELECT 'BANK' kind,b.id,b.subject_id,b.id question_bank_id,NULL::uuid chapter_id,NULL::uuid question_id,b.name title,left(b.description,240) summary,NULL::text question_type FROM banks b WHERE #{questionType}::text IS NULL AND (position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(b.name))>0 OR position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(b.description))>0) UNION ALL SELECT 'CHAPTER',c.id,b.subject_id,b.id,c.id,NULL::uuid,c.name,left(b.name,240),NULL::text FROM chapter c JOIN banks b ON b.id=c.bank_id WHERE #{questionType}::text IS NULL AND position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(c.name))>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'QUESTION',q.id,b.subject_id,b.id,q.chapter_id,q.id,left(r.stem,120),left(r.stem,240),r.type FROM question q JOIN banks b ON b.id=q.bank_id JOIN question_revision r ON r.id=q.current_revision_id WHERE question_active(q.id) AND (q.reading_parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question parent WHERE parent.id=q.reading_parent_id AND parent.status='ACTIVE')) AND (#{questionType}::text IS NULL OR r.type=#{questionType}) AND (position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(r.stem))>0 OR position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(r.content_data::jsonb->>'passage'))>0) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY kind,title,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
